free_tier.stated: 100 million free tokens assigned to each new account, no payment details required; free-tier limits are 1,000 API requests, 1,000,000 input tokens and 100,000 output tokens per minute
free_tier.notes: the quick-start page words the grant as 'initially assigned' to each new user and points to the billing page when the tokens run low; no monthly renewal is stated

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client against https://api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1, or the vendor SDKs (pip install inceptionai, npm install inceptionai)
chaining: a large one-off token grant with a high per-minute ceiling, suited to a burst of batch calls before any paid plan; the grant, not the rate, is the scarce link

limits.value: 100 million free tokens per new account; billing information is requested when they run low
Free Tier per minute: 1,000 API requests, 1,000,000 input tokens, 100,000 output tokens (Pay As You Go: 3,000 requests, 3,000,000 input, 300,000 output)

identity_cost.detail: no payment details required, quoted from the quick-start page; the sign-up form itself was not captured, so any further check on it is not established

reliability_note: a one-off grant rather than a renewing allowance: once the 100 million tokens are spent the account needs billing information
confidence_note: the grant and the per-minute limits are quoted from the vendor's quick-start and rate-limit pages; no call was made. Renewal behaviour and the sign-up form are not established.

evidence.proved: each new account gets 100 million free tokens and no payment details are required
evidence.quote: Every new account includes 100 million free tokens — no payment details required.

evidence.quote: When your free tokens are running low, navigate to [Billing](https://platform.inceptionlabs.ai/dashboard/billing) to add your payment information for continued usage beyond the free tier.

evidence.proved: free tier allows 1,000 API requests per minute (3,000 on Pay As You Go)
free tier allows 1,000,000 input tokens per minute
free tier allows 100,000 output tokens per minute
